fixtures.preview: United visit fourth-placed Liverpool at Anfield (4:30pm UK, 3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney) sitting 18th after a 4-4 draw with Aston Villa.
talking_points: Sky's table (as of 8 Nov) has United 18th with 8 points from 10 (1 win, 5 draws, 4 losses), in the relegation zone; Liverpool are 4th on 18.
Against Villa, United conceded twice inside four minutes and trailed 4-2 before Zirkzee and a 96th-minute Dorgu header earned a point.
Michael Carrick said afterwards he will not walk away; reports name Eddie Howe and Julian Nagelsmann as contenders if he is dismissed.
Injury and line-up news for both sides isn't confirmed yet.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon (8pm local, 7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney), a few days after Anfield and after United's 3-2 win over Roma on 3 Nov.
Brentford visit Old Trafford on Saturday 28 Nov at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney).
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at 8pm UK time (7am Thu 3 Dec Sydney); fixtures are subject to change.
Coventry visit Old Trafford on Saturday 5 Dec at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 6 Dec Sydney).
Matchweek 5 in Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney), after Sydney's 4-1 home win over Central Coast on 6 Nov.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure scored his second Sydney FC hat-trick in the 4-1 win over Central Coast on 6 Nov, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first goal for the club.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo said after that win that 'the best is yet to come'.
Ben Garuccio has called for Allianz Stadium to be a 'fortress', but this one is away in Brisbane.
The squad for Brisbane isn't named yet, and no injury list or ladder position was found.

notes: Refreshed Sat 14 Nov. Search returned mostly stale results and many club, venue and ticketing pages blocked access, so several items were carried over from the 13 Nov run and not re-opened. Items marked 'earlier check' were not re-verified.

Dropped as finished: Qatar v Socceroos (result not found), MADD Night, and the Krispy Kreme, Rebel and adidas offers. Alex Lloyd was cut to make room for Melanie C and C.W. Stoneking. Iron Maiden's time now follows Sydney Music's guide (6pm).
Man Utd and Sydney FC: re-checked Sky Sports fixtures and the 8 Nov table, and the Sydney FC news page. No current team news was found for Liverpool or Brisbane, so those previews are unchanged.

Man Utd: fixtures were checked against Sky Sports; the table (18th, 8 points) is from Sky as of 8 Nov, and Villa match detail comes from search summaries. Liverpool's recent form and any team news weren't found.
Sydney FC: Brisbane (6:40pm) and Auckland (5pm) times come from the A-Leagues page with no stated time zone, so they are treated as local times. No ladder or injury list was found.

Big matches: Champions League kick-offs use UEFA's default 21:00 CET; the Nations Championship fixtures were carried over from rugby.com.au and not re-opened. Jordan v Socceroos has no confirmed time, so 12:00 local is a placeholder. Real Madrid v PSV was dropped to stay within the limit.

Local: no local news from the last 7 days was found. School events come from the Term 4 calendars and the Week 5 Principal Updates (dates may change); nothing was found for the second school or South Eveleigh. The Bush Food Tour and Abilities Unleashed items were carried over and not re-opened.
Live sport: no Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas games were found in the window; only the Kings' 15 Nov home game was confirmed, and other Kings home dates weren't available.

Arts: gig times come from Sydney Music's gig guide (no prices listed); the Dracula season was dropped as it couldn't be re-confirmed. Boyz II Men (4 Dec) is sold out; Remi Wolf (Enmore, 15 Dec) falls outside the window, and Beck's tour is Melbourne only.

Son and daughter: nothing confirmed for Pokémon, Minecraft or Roblox events within 4 weeks (a Minecraft Experience opens at Luna Park on 18 Dec and a Pokémon card party is on in Blacktown on 12 Dec), nor for a junior parkrun near home or Sydney kids' author events. Sydney FC's summer holiday clinics (ages 5–13) were announced but dates weren't found.
Groceries: half-price lines come from an OzBargain roundup of the 11–17 Nov NSW catalogues; no half-price fresh fruit, veg, eggs or wholegrain bread were listed. Aldi items have no was-price.

Deals: Black Friday sales are expected from about 23 Nov (a forecast, not confirmed). Krispy Kreme and Event Cinemas offers were carried over and not re-opened; the Affordable Art Fair was dropped as it ended 8 Nov.
Horizon was carried over from the previous run and not re-researched, apart from the Diana Ross note.
